The Fock-base definition supplies bar-fixed triangular charts and reverse delta forms, not the upper Kashiwara hypotheses or Chevalley leading-term filtration. The highest-constituent global-basis theorem applies only on V(Lambda), not all tensor constituents. Read all11 direct dependencies, CR categorical source proofs, and visually read Kashiwara Global crystal bases printed pp.469–474 (PDF14–19): upper-crystal convention preceding5.1, balanced hypotheses5.1.1, kernel Lemma5.1.1/Corollary5.1.2, filtration Proposition5.2.1–5.2.3 and complete Proposition5.3.1 with (5.3.8). Proposition5.3.1 requires balanced upper-chart data on this actual module; it does not create that chart or identify categorical simples with source L. Attempted local closure uses the new complete height proof for abstract head/socle and the existing reverse pairing for form duality, but I have not established its adjoint operator and balanced-string transport on every full-tensor constituent, and the KL simple-class identification still inherits reader:23:2. Required owner decision: supply/review a local full-tensor balanced upper-chart/Chevalley leading-term lemma and the independent KL bridge, then compare maximal-height simple factors with its tableau strings. Leave the label and vanishing assertions, findings and risk open; no narrowing or withdrawal. Reader categorical gap repaired in Proof3.1–3.4 by defining hplus,hminus,d, proving height-preserving Serre filtration and the adjunction bound on head/socle height, proving extremal divided translate simplicity by integral positive class multiplicities, and using complementary Hecke restriction plus endomorphism/composition multiplicity bounds before the general-simple multiplicity-one adjunction. The simple head forces indecomposability; commuting D and a self-dual input give self-duality directly. Chuang–Rouquier math/0407205 pp.13–14 Lemma4.3, pp.17–18 Lemmas5.11–5.12 and pp.20–21 Proposition5.20 with complete proofs were read. This is the closed component f44-six-step-b23-categorical-height; no tableau-label closure is inferred.
